The '''2021 World Championship''' was the 26th Star Wars CCG World Championship, held by the [[Players Committee]] at the Hyatt Regency Crystal City in Arlington, Virginia, over the weekend of 8–10 October 2021, with four sanctioned events across three days.<ref name="wrap" /> (The hub previously gave 7–10 October; the wrap-up gives 8–10 October.) Sixty players entered the main event.<ref name="wrap" /> [[Joe Olson]] defended his 2020 title by defeating [[Matt Scott]] in the Final Confrontation, with Agents Of Black Sun and Qui-Gon Communing;<ref name="wrap" /><ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-world-championships/ 2021 World Championships], starwarsccg.org</ref> it was his fourth straight major win. He became the sixth player to win two World Championships and the second, after [[Bastian Winkelhaus]], to win in consecutive years.<ref name="wrap" /> Olson was inducted into the Players Committee Hall of Fame on 9 October 2021, just before Game 1 of the main event.<ref name="wrap" /><ref name="awards" />

=== Top 8 bracket ===

Every player at 6–2 or better made the cut. [[Jared Napolitano]] finished Day 1 first, followed by the other 7–1 players [[Tom Haid]] and [[Matt Scott]]; [[Greg Shaw]], [[Barry Alperstein]], [[Robbie Hendon]], [[Casey Anis]] and [[Joe Olson]] (8th on Day 1) completed the Top 8.<ref name="wrap" />
* '''Quarterfinals:''' Olson def. Shaw; Scott def. Hendon.<ref name="wrap" />
* '''Semifinals:''' Olson def. Napolitano; Scott def. Alperstein.<ref name="wrap" />
* '''Final:''' Olson def. Scott.<ref name="wrap" />

The other two quarterfinal results and all game scores were not published.

== Side events ==

* '''Team tournament''' (Friday evening, 18 teams, glass mug trophies): won by "Stop Batmouse Cold", [[Dan Tartaglione]] and [[Brad Reinhold]]. "Potential Allies" ([[Charlie Arlandson]] and [[Amar Banger]]) finished second.<ref name="wrap" />
* '''Consolation''' (Sunday, 28 players): won by [[Anthony Howard]] at 5–1; [[Ryan Jellison]], [[Chris Gogolen]] and [[Sam Tashima]] finished 2nd–4th.<ref name="wrap" />
* '''Hall of Fame:''' [[Joe Olson]], enshrined 9 October 2021, introduced by [[Phil Aasen]].<ref name="wrap" /><ref name="awards" />
* '''[[2021 Worlds Throwback Event|Throwback Event]]''' (Friday 8 October, six-game Swiss, Premiere–Reflections II cards only): [[Steve Skilton]] went 6–0 to win, ahead of [[Jared Napolitano]], [[Matt Carulli]] and [[Kevin Elia]]. The wrap-up gives a field of 15; the published results list 16 pairs.<ref name="wrap" /><ref name="tb">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-worlds-retro-prem-ref-ii-event/ 2021 Worlds Throwback Event], starwarsccg.org</ref>
